prompts.lettering:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production raster UI lettering atlas for a premium dark biological sci-fi game. Generate entirely original hand-painted and sculpted lettering, NOT a typeset font, NOT generic italic sans-serif. Transparent background.
Layout: one square atlas divided into EXACTLY TWO COLUMNS and THREE ROWS, six equal rectangular cells. No visible grid lines. Each cell has one isolated horizontal wordmark, all strokes fully inside its cell with 8% transparent margins. The six wordmarks, in reading order, are:
top-left: "BIO TITAN"
top-right: "VENOM TITAN"
middle-left: "WARNING"
middle-right: "CONTAINMENT BREACH"
bottom-left: "PHASE"
bottom-right: "COLOSSAL LIFEFORM"
Spell every word exactly, one line per cell, no wrapping. Use large readable letterforms. Primary names should be wide, imposing and beautifully custom drawn: extended angular characters with deliberate sharp notches, distinctive cut B, O, T, A, N construction, crisp platinum/bone faces, dark gunmetal depth, fine crimson biological vein inlay, restrained red edge-light. BIO TITAN gets very subtle hot orange fissures; VENOM TITAN gets very subtle acidic green vein accents while remaining mainly pale silver for legibility. A coherent original alphabet, almost horizontal rather than heavy stock italic. Carefully sculpted asymmetric cuts in thick letter stems, luxurious premium game title treatment, controlled detail, strong silhouette. WARNING is crimson illuminated industrial lettering with carved silver edges, compact and very legible. The three small UI labels use the same hand-drawn angular design in pale warm silver with thin red accents, no tiny unreadable texture.
Avoid ornamental clutter, rounded cartoony shapes, skulls, wings, excessive bevel, neon blur, illegible spikes, extraneous words or logos. No plates, panels or scene, only the painted lettering with true alpha transparency. No shadow rectangle or opaque matte. This replaces stock-font text in the actual game, so each exact wordmark must be clearly readable and cleanly separable.
prompts.crest_digits:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production UI crest and countdown glyph atlas for a premium dark biological sci-fi boss cinematic. Square image with a TRUE transparent background, EXACTLY TWO COLUMNS and TWO ROWS of equal square cells, no grid lines. Four isolated items in reading order:
top-left: an imposing original TITAN threat crest. A narrow luminous molten-red vertical predator pupil enclosed by layered blackened biomechanical carapace, three sharp hooked claw blades and ribbed bone/metal arcs framing the core. Balanced near-symmetry, triangular spear-like silhouette, brutal sophisticated biological containment insignia, dimensional but compact and readable when small. Obsidian metal, bone-silver cutting edges, tiny red ember seams, dark red inner glow. No literal cartoon skull, no horns-on-a-cute-face, no diamond or shield backing, no background. It must look like a high-end boss mark, not a generic hazard icon. Strong clean outer silhouette and obvious central slit eye.
top-right: the single numeral "1"
bottom-left: the single numeral "2"
bottom-right: the single numeral "3"
The three numerals must be individually hand-painted/sculpted original game glyphs: broad sharp angular construction, platinum-bone face, thin crimson biological vein inlays and red rim light, matching the threatening crest's material quality. Large clear numerals, NOT ordinary typeset font, no blur. All items fully inside their own equal cell with 12% transparent margin. Digits have matching height and baseline. No other text, letters, numbers, labels, borders, boxes, ground, black matte or extra objects. True alpha transparency between and around all four items.
prompts.lettering_background_extraction: Use case: background-extraction. Image 1 is the exact finished lettering atlas to edit. Remove ONLY the brown/gray gradient background and all background haze. Genuine alpha=0 outside metal letters and between openings. Preserve all six wordmarks EXACTLY: BIO TITAN, VENOM TITAN, WARNING, CONTAINMENT BREACH, PHASE, COLOSSAL LIFEFORM. Preserve spelling, carved hand-painted shapes, materials, colors, detail, positions and two-column three-row layout. Do not redraw, reposition, add or remove lettering, bevels or veins. Preserve sharp opaque edge highlights, no matte or black rectangle. Truly transparent cutout atlas, not a colored or checkerboard scene. Keep canvas framing and aspect unchanged.
